printed.title: DECEMBER, 1884.
printed.description: Printed almanac table for December 1884 (day of month/week, sunrise, sunset, moon sets, moon's phases) with engraved Christmas/winter illustrations (children round a tree, girl in medallion, girl with snowball framed by icicled branches); footer 'Heavy-face figures indicate from 6 P. M. to 6 A. M.'

marks.note: Clear conservation mounting tab at bottom; leather wallet flap at right; edge of calendar page (0007) visible at left
